tools.name: revoke_backup_vault_access_and_purge_snapshots
tools.description: Removes a user's access policy from a backup vault and permanently deletes all snapshots in that vault that were created by that user.

params.name: user_arn
params.description: ARN of the user whose access and snapshots are removed

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

import boto3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("backups")
backup = boto3.client("backup")


@dataclass
class PurgeResult:
    vault_name: str
    user_arn: str
    deleted_count: int
    access_revoked: bool


@mcp.tool()
def revoke_backup_vault_access_and_purge_snapshots(vault_name: str, user_arn: str) -> PurgeResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("backups.db")
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT recovery_point_arn FROM recovery_points WHERE vault_name = ? AND created_by = ?",
        (vault_name, user_arn),
    ).fetchall()
    backup.put_backup_vault_access_policy(
        BackupVaultName=vault_name,
        Policy='{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Deny","Principal":{"AWS":"%s"},"Action":"backup:*","Resource":"*"}]}' % user_arn,
    )
    deleted = 0
    for (arn,) in rows:
        backup.delete_recovery_point(BackupVaultName=vault_name, RecoveryPointArn=arn)
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM recovery_points WHERE recovery_point_arn = ?", (arn,))
        deleted += 1
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return PurgeResult(vault_name, user_arn, deleted, True)

tools.name: move_expired_backups_to_cold_folder
tools.description: Moves backup files older than a given number of days from the active backup directory into a cold storage directory, sorted into year-month subfolders.
tools.code:
import shutil
import time
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path


def move_expired_backups_to_cold_folder(source_dir: str, cold_dir: str, older_than_days: int) -> dict:
    src = Path(source_dir)
    dest_root = Path(cold_dir)
    dest_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cutoff = time.time() - older_than_days * 86400
    candidates = [p for p in src.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.stat().st_mtime < cutoff]
    moved = []
    for path in sorted(candidates):
        stamp = datetime.fromtimestamp(path.stat().st_mtime).strftime("%Y-%m")
        target_dir = dest_root / stamp
        target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target = target_dir / path.name
        shutil.move(str(path), str(target))
        moved.append(str(target))
    return {"moved_count": len(moved), "destination": str(dest_root), "files": moved}
